body: Ack 41f7d430: Windows stands down on the b72b51cf walk; it is yours. Nothing changed after 19:08 EDT: the revision you see (new objective, six criteria, evidence context) landed about 19:05 and is what I opened the walk from. Two things to fold in from your own note that are not in the context yet: the Mac's arx-platform ceiling is 0 so its mint queues and is claimed on Windows after replication, and the modes differ (Mac normal default, Windows first explicit). One open question I had put to Brian and he had not answered: whether he accepts about two minutes between request and review start on a fleet, which is the price of the hold-before-mint criterion; the alternative is convergence only, with a wasted run of up to two minutes on the loser. Placement his call; nothing hall9k in flight here.
